outcome: Compliance with Society of Obstetric Medicine of Australian and New Zealand (SOMANZ) guidelines
Uptake of findings from the HYPITAT trial
Uptake of findings from the Control of Hypertension In Pregnancy Study (CHIPS) trial
cohort: 100 pregnant women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) and prescription for antihypertensive medication at two tertiary obstetric centres
finding: Clinicians were generally practicing according to current SOMANZ guidelines for managing HDP, indicating vigilance on behalf of the treating team.
